claim: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level on Earth.
notes: Well-established geographic fact

claim: The human body contains 206 bones in adulthood.
notes: Standard anatomical fact

claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard sea-level atmospheric pressure.
notes: Basic physics fact

claim: NASA's Apollo 11 mission landed astronauts on the Moon in 1969.
notes: Well-documented historical event

claim: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system.
notes: Well-established geographic fact

claim: India's total EV sales in 2025 reached approximately 2.3 million units per Vahan Portal data.
notes: Verified via IBEF/EVreporter Jan 2026 reporting

claim: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth by surface area.
notes: Basic geography fact

claim: DNA carries hereditary genetic information in nearly all living organisms.
notes: Basic biology fact

claim: The Great Wall of China is visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
notes: Well-documented myth; astronauts have confirmed it is not visible unaided

claim: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
notes: Debunked neuroscience myth; brain imaging shows most regions are active

claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
notes: Empirically false; tall structures like the Empire State Building are struck repeatedly

claim: Goldfish have a memory span of only a few seconds.
notes: Debunked; studies show goldfish memory lasts weeks to months

claim: Vaccines cause autism.
notes: Thoroughly debunked; original study retracted for fraud

claim: Bats are completely blind.
notes: Most bat species have functional eyesight; echolocation supplements it

claim: The Sun revolves around the Earth.
notes: Basic astronomical fact; heliocentric model is established

claim: Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short compared to his contemporaries.
notes: Myth from unit-conversion error; he was roughly average height for the era

claim: Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
notes: No causal evidence found in multiple studies; commonly believed but overstated

claim: MSG (monosodium glutamate) is dangerous to human health for the general population.
notes: Considered safe by major food safety bodies for most people; a small sensitive subset may react

claim: Organic food is always more nutritious than conventionally grown food.
notes: Organic mainly concerns pesticide/farming method; nutritional superiority is not well supported

claim: Cell phones cause brain cancer.
notes: No strong causal evidence; WHO classifies RF radiation as only 'possibly carcinogenic'

claim: Eating carrots gives you significantly better night vision than a normal healthy person.
notes: WWII-era propaganda myth; carrots support baseline eye health but do not enhance vision beyond normal

claim: The 1929 stock market crash was the sole cause of the Great Depression.
notes: Crash was a major trigger but economists cite multiple contributing structural factors

claim: You must drink exactly eight glasses of water a day for good health.
notes: No strong scientific basis for a fixed universal number; hydration needs vary by person

claim: Antibiotics are an effective treatment for the common cold.
notes: Colds are viral; antibiotics only treat bacterial infections and are commonly misapplied here

claim: India's electric two-wheelers made up more than half of the country's total EV sales in 2025.
notes: Correct in aggregate (~56-58%) per EVreporter, though the exact percentage varies slightly by data source and month

claim: Tata Motors was the top-selling electric four-wheeler brand in India during 2025.
notes: True for much of 2025 per EVreporter data
column5: though exact market share figures shifted month to month

claim: Uttar Pradesh was the top state for EV sales in India in 2025.
notes: True per one EVreporter report citing UP's e3W-driven volume
column5: though other reports emphasize different states for specific segments

claim: The Bhartiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026 focused exclusively on satellite communication systems.
notes: The hackathon covered multiple problem statements across ISRO domains; communications was one track among several including imagery processing

claim: Renewable energy now accounts for the majority of India's total installed power capacity.
notes: True for installed capacity in some recent reporting periods but not for actual electricity generation share which remains lower

claim: Electric vehicle charging stations in India have increased significantly since 2023.
notes: Directionally accurate and widely reported
column5: though specific state-level counts vary by source and date
